headline: Knee-high SE leftovers, glassy at dawn — log it or sleep in.
today: Small SE swell, 1.8ft on the sets at a good angle but nothing with much push. Dawn WNW is cross-off and cleanest, then WSW-W cross fills in through the day and just adds texture. Grab the log around the early low pushing toward the 6:23a high and don't expect much more than that.

daysToWatch.note: Biggest swell of the week and a prime ESE angle to 3.5ft, but S wind cranks onshore 13 to 21mph. Prime angle wasted — a dawn peek at best before it blows out.
The clean one at home. NNE offshore 12-14mph over 2ft at a good angle — best window is dawn through late morning before the WSW cross swings in. Log or fish.
